reason: The Note under Denying permissions on the Setting up Parameter Store page states both parts verbatim: the default AWS KMS key has Decrypt permission for all IAM principals in the account, and for different access levels to SecureString parameters AWS does not recommend the default key. Scope and condition match.

The cross-account page, in the step about the KMS key policy in Account1, says the needed KMS permissions depend on the operations: kms:Decrypt to read the secret value, plus kms:GenerateDataKey if the principal also creates or changes the secret value. Scope (principal in Account2, key in Account1) and all conditions match.
